messages:
nina: quick sync: planning a kernel+quant deploy (runtime-kernel@v2.16-quantlz4) during the midnight window 02:00-03:00 UTC. small change: new allocator tweak that reduces host mem but may change GC timings.

omar: noted. last time GC jitter caused p95 blips on long requests. recommend slow ramp: 5% -> 30% -> 100% with 12m dwell.

li: agreed. also enable KV-cache-prefill for canary to avoid cold-miss noise. ops-bot can toggle the prefill flag.

trent: i'll own rollback. threshold: p95 +35ms sustained for 4m OR gc_pause_rate > 0.1% in 5m -> rollback. who flips the global pin?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime-kernel@v2.16-quantlz4 canary 5% at 2024-11-07T02:00:00Z. cancel: `/deploy cancel 1748723456`. fallback pin: runtime-kernel@v2.15.

ops-bot: preflight: cluster-health ok, prefill available, telemetry hooks: p50,p95,gc_pause_count,kvmiss_rate. smoke: 3/3 passed. Will unmute alerts for window and post 10m summaries.

omar: add quick curl check for gc pause: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://telemetry.internal/series?name=gc_pause_count&window=5m` -> expect <2.

trent: rollback steps (I own): 1) `/deploy cancel 1748723456` 2) `/deploy pin runtime-kernel@v2.15 --global` 3) disable kv-cache-prefill flag 4) post incident stub if >500 requests affected.

nina: ok, owners ack?

omar: ack - monitoring.

li: ack - will toggle prefill and check cold-miss telemetry.

trent: ack - rollback owner.

ops-bot: reminders set. Good luck! :shipit:
